title: Cuboids
description: You can create your own cuboid and be safe from other players!
body:
# Cuboid Datapack

This datapack adds a land claiming system that allows players to create and manage their own protected plots of land in Minecraft! Perfect for survival servers, SMP worlds, or realms with multiple players.

- Claim Your Own Land – Players can create personal plots to reserve a piece of the world just for themselves.
- Grief Protection – Only the plot owner (or trusted players) can build or break blocks within their claim.
- Share Your Cuboid – Allow friends to access and build on your land.
- Lightweight & Vanilla-Friendly – 100% datapack-based with no mods required!
